_comment: Maps YOUR folder names onto library facets. Copy this to folder_map.json
and edit it -- fix_facets.py loads that file if present, otherwise falls
back to the generic defaults below.
Only 'division' is likely to need editing: those are the top-level folders
of your own tree, which nobody else shares. The other three are ordinary
debate conventions and usually work as-is.
Facets are derived from the folder a file sat in BEFORE flattening, read
from the manifest that flatten_backfile.py writes. That is how the old
hierarchy survives as searchable metadata instead of being lost.

division._comment: top-level folder -> which debate format it belongs to

_comment: Folder names that describe FILING rather than subject matter, so they
are never treated as a topic. Without this you get topics called 'Dump'
A real topic is the folder directly under a 'Topics' folder --
Everywhere else no topic is claimed, because guessing one is worse than
